Tara CSM: Quick alert
AtlasWorks reported spikes of 429s during their integration test. They asked for a brief QPS increase + IP allowlist for their test runners so onboarding isn't blocked.
Noah NetOps: Got it. Which IPs and which regions? Also want start/end times and auto-revoke preference.
Tara CSM: IPs: 192.0.2.77/32 (test runner) and 198.51.100.128/25 (staging). Regions: us-east1 for integration, asia-east1 for partners observing. Window: 90 minutes starting 09:30 ET. Auto-revoke yes. Please mark meta:renewal_watch:medium.
Evan AM: This onboarding demo impacts their renewal in 4w. If we can avoid failures that'll keep them on track.
Noah NetOps: I'll add the CIDRs to ingress allowlist and open a temporary rate-window on key atlaswks-integ-0930. ETA ~10m. @Ticket Bot please open CS ticket.
Ticket Bot: Created ticket CS-9755  temporary qps bump + ingress allowlist. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-9755
Riya Support: I'll spin up a short dashboard to monitor 429/5xx and annotate the bump window. Give me the key name and I'll set alerts (429 > 2% or 5xx > 0.4%).
Tara CSM: Key: atlaswks-test-09-30. Rotate after the window, please redact in public channels. Capture any failed request ids and sample payloads.
Kai Eng: Small routing idea: route telemetry and webhook traffic to a low-cost small-model to reduce token pressure during the bump. Example rule:
```
if header.x-customer == "atlasworks" and path startswith "/webhook":
  route_to: small-webhook
  qps: 15
else:
  apply rate-window: 7rps
```
Kai Eng: Not necessary but could help keep critical integrations responsive.
Noah NetOps: Applied CIDRs and rate-window. Auto-revoke scheduled at 11:00 ET. Tagged logs with customer:atlasworks and session:integ-2026-04-05. Will post peering IP when ready.
Riya Support: Dashboards live and annotated CS-9755. Pager set if thresholds exceeded.
Noah NetOps: Peering IP provisioned 34.123.200.12. CS-9755 updated with revert job.
Evan AM: I'll run the integration at 09:45 ET and gather NPS + any UX notes. Tara, I'll send a quick renewal update after.
Tara CSM: Checklist: [x] CIDRs added, [x] rate-window scheduled, [x] dashboards + alerts, [x] ticket CS-9755, [ ] post-integration NPS + error samples. I'll post results here after the session. :rocket:
